question: Should memory-lancedb rely on LanceDB’s existOk creation semantics as the supported cross-process initialization contract for both local and URI-backed stores?
rationale: The patch and proof support this design, but the PR carries an explicit human-review pause and no repository-maintainer-authored comment has accepted the dependency boundary.

options.title: Accept LanceDB atomic creation
options.body: Approve the dependency-native existOk approach, refresh the exact head, and land once required gates pass.

options.title: Require remote-store proof
options.body: Keep the implementation but require a targeted URI-backed concurrency demonstration before landing.

options.title: Choose another locking contract
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a different cross-process initialization design despite the additional portability and maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Accept LanceDB atomic creation
recommendation.body: Approve the dependency-native existOk approach, refresh the exact head, and land once required gates pass.
